decision: Which approach best resolves: WF-071 stamps a per-viewer watermark on a WF-121 tracked link. The spec says the WatermarkConfig is stored on the Link row. WF-121's normalise_link returns a fixed key set and its update_link re-normalises the merged payload, so any watermark key written onto the link row is dropped the next time a rep edits that link through WF-121's own PATCH route.

state.problem: WF-071 stamps a per-viewer watermark on a WF-121 tracked link. The spec says the WatermarkConfig is stored on the Link row. WF-121's normalise_link returns a fixed key set and its update_link re-normalises the merged payload, so any watermark key written onto the link row is dropped the next time a rep edits that link through WF-121's own PATCH route.

candidate_solutions.dedicated_collection: Store the watermark toggle and config in a new namespaced collection wf071_watermark, keyed by link_id (the WF-121 link id) and room_ref. GET joins the WF-121 link with the config and always returns watermark_config or null. Reuses WF-121's link and viewer vocabulary by import, adds no migration, and survives any edit made through WF-121's own routes.
candidate_solutions.on_link_row: Write enable_watermark and watermark_config into the WF-121 link row's data with a direct audited store.update, so the config literally lives on the Link row as the spec describes. Accepts that WF-121's own update_link drops the key on the next edit, which loses a rep's watermark settings silently.
candidate_solutions.on_gated_link: Store the config on the WF-069 gated link, whose settings already pass enable_watermark and watermark_config through untouched and which owns the email_protected gate the {{email}} token depends on. Breaks the brief's instruction to reuse WF-121's link vocabulary and makes the watermark unavailable on a link WF-069 did not gate.

context.brief: Reuse WF-121's link, viewer and revisit vocabulary instead of re-declaring it.
context.house_rule: Records are ordinary JSON in records.data; no migration, no typed column.
context.failure_if_wrong: A rep's watermark text disappears on the next link edit and the leak trace is lost.
